title_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 健康科技學院 助理教授 ‧ 台灣醫療救護學會 秘書長
title_en: Assistant Professor, College of Health Technology, National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Sciences ‧ Secretary-General, Taiwan Society of Paramedicine
tags_zh: 智慧醫療與 VR 應用
about_zh: 張育通博士致力於結合行為科學、健康科技與生物統計，強化緊急醫療系統（EMS）與社區災難應變之韌性。具備豐富的到院前救護實務經驗，曾於台灣及澳洲從事緊急救護工作，深刻了解第一線人員的現場挑戰。目前任職於國立臺北護理健康大學健康科技學院，擔任助理教授，並兼任台灣醫療救護學會秘書長。持續推動醫療救護人員專業發展、職業安全，以及創新數位學習模式的研究與實踐。研究興趣涵蓋到院前救護、災難管理、緊急救護人員心理健康、空間分析應用於 EMS 資料，以及社區急救教育推廣。
about_en: Dr. Yu-Tung Chang works at the intersection of behavioral science, health technology, and biostatistics to strengthen the resilience of emergency medical services (EMS) and community disaster response. With extensive prehospital care experience in both Taiwan and Australia, he brings firsthand understanding of frontline challenges. He is currently an Assistant Professor at the College of Health Technology, National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Sciences, and Secretary-General of the Taiwan Society of Paramedicine. His research spans prehospital care, disaster management, EMS personnel mental health, spatial analysis of EMS data, and community first-aid education.
